filters.name: Measure Topological Properties
filters.shortDescription: Compute a set of topological measures over a mesh.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Compute a set of topological measures over a mesh.

filters.name: Measure Topological Properties for Quad Mesh
filters.shortDescription: Compute a set of topological measures over a quad mesh.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Compute a set of topological measures over a quad mesh.

filters.name: Measure Geometric Properties
filters.shortDescription: Compute a set of geometric measures of a mesh or point cloud.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Compute a set of geometric measures of a mesh/pointcloud. Bounding box extents and diagonal, principal axis, thin shell barycenter (mesh only), vertex barycenter and quality-weighted barycenter (pointcloud only), surface area (mesh only), volume (closed mesh) and inertia tensor matrix (closed mesh).

filters.name: Measure Selection Area and Perimeter
filters.shortDescription: Compute area and perimeter of the face selection.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Compute area and perimeter of the FACE selection.

filters.name: Measure Vertex Scalar Statistics
filters.shortDescription: Compute aggregate statistics over per-vertex quality.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Compute some aggregate statistics over the per vertex quality, like Min, Max, Average, StdDev and Variance.

filters.name: Measure Face Scalar Statistics
filters.shortDescription: Compute aggregate statistics over per-face quality.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Compute some aggregate statistics over the per face quality, like Min, Max, Average, StdDev and Variance.

filters.name: Measure Vertex Scalar Histogram
filters.shortDescription: Compute a histogram of per-vertex quality values.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Compute an histogram of the values of the per-vertex quality. It can be useful to evaluate the distribution of the quality value over the surface. It can be discrete (e.g. based on vertex count or area weighted).

parameters.label: Hist Min
parameters.help: Lower bound of the histogram range.

parameters.label: Hist Max
parameters.help: Upper bound of the histogram range.

parameters.label: Area Weighted
parameters.help: If false, each bin reports the number of vertices in the range. If true, each bin reports the approximate mesh area associated with those values.

parameters.label: Bin Number
parameters.help: The number of bins of the histogram.

filters.name: Measure Face Scalar Histogram
filters.shortDescription: Compute a histogram of per-face quality values.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Compute an histogram of the values of the per-face quality.

parameters.label: Hist Min
parameters.help: Lower bound of the histogram range.

parameters.label: Hist Max
parameters.help: Upper bound of the histogram range.

parameters.label: Area Weighted
parameters.help: If false, each bin reports the number of faces in the range. If true, each bin reports the approximate area in that range.

parameters.label: Bin Number
parameters.help: The number of bins of the histogram.
